short_description: Design services for City Hall data center upgrades, backup expansion, cabling, and security improvements.
project_scope: Upgrade and expand data center facilities at City Hall after relocation to the fifth floor. Scope includes additional document digitization, area preparation, security measures, equipment racks, ancillary protection systems, and new cabling throughout City Hall to replace aging and clustered infrastructure. The city also intends to expand backup capacity with additional data centers.
